text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
My, it's so lush here... Hehe. I'm looking
forward to feeling the sunny
breeze.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
On a day off, I bring Yamanin Zephyr to
the zoo in hopes of fulfilling
an odd
request.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Siiigh... Sigh... It's as though a storm of petals clouds my way.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Trainer. Hello there. The thing is... I've
been craving a good
breeze through the
open sky, like out in nature.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Except... here in the city, the wind just
howls dryly around the
buildings.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
It really is quite lively, like the coastal
wind stirring up the waves. Just
look at
everyone, shaking with excitement as
though stirred by the
first gust of spring.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She loves animals, so I figured the zoo
would catch her interest. She
already looks
curious about all the unusual critters
around, so I'm sure
she'll have a blast.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, the spring current leads down into
this corner, huh?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I swivel around, half-panicked, then spot
her over in the corner of a
rest area.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Hm? I am looking at them. See? Look at
little Plip-Plop here.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I follow her gaze to a damp patch of
shade, where a little frog is
sleeping.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
And if you look that way, there's a whole
Stripey family. They're
having a little
picnic by the trees.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Zephyr watches chipmunks dart around
the trees with acorns, a soft
smile on her
face.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I guess frogs and chipmunks aren't
something you see every day in the
city,
but they're not that uncommon either.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Look how they wander with the
wind, like adventurers playing
a game.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Seeing her smile, I realize that these little wild creatures are what Zephyr missed. This is nature.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I get the feeling... if I follow her lead here,
I'll get a clearer picture of
who she is and
what she holds dear.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Chirp, chirp. Chirp, chirp.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Oh, my, if it isn't the Chubby Cheeks. Are
you little birdies playing
tag?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A couple of polka-dot-cheeked tree
sparrows whoosh by, and Zephyr
drifts
along after them. We follow the birds all
the way out to a quiet
trail around the
edge of the zoo.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
There's something magical about the
scenery—something special
about the
everyday sparrows and starlings flitting
around Zephyr.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Lu la laaa, la laaa lun... ♪

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, hello to you too, Orangey. Would
you care to dance in the
wind with us?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Yes. A good name is like a floral
breeze—it picks up only the
sweetest of
scents.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The starling does have a distinctly orange
beak and feet. I can kinda
see where she
got the nickname.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I want to try experiencing the natural
world like she does, so I come
up with a
nickname for the bird myself.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Mr. Snazzy... Mr. Snazzy, huh? Hehe...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
How kind of you! The name definitely
shows a lot of your personality.
Sweet, like
a gentle wind of spring.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
I like the way he sings. It's like listening to
the homeward wind,
calling me back to a
warm place I've always known.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
It's such a pleasant surprise, finding a wind
in the city reminiscent of
the nature I grew
up with.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
...Oh. I... I almost let the wind sweep me
away for a second there.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
I could have sworn... I heard the flow of
the wind itself in the song. A
meandering
melody, soaring freely, tirelessly through
the woods.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: But how could that be?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
I'd always thought one could only hear the
wind's song when their
heart was
still—listening so quietly, carefully.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: And yet... listen.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
The beautiful music is here playing with us,
clear as the easterlies
through a cloudless
sky.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
There's nothing in the way, so the wind
can go any which way it
pleases. I never
thought I'd be so lucky as to feel it like
this.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
...The wind does strange things when
you're around. Or at least, that's
how it
sometimes feels.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Thank you ever so much for today. You
whooshed the rain clouds
away and
cleared up my heart.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Oh... "Again"... If ever there's an
opportunity, when our winds once
more
align...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She skirts around my question, giving a
vague, noncommittal answer
again, but...
this time, it makes sense. It feels so
natural.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The winds make no promises, but it'd be
nice if they crossed again
somewhere...
And when they do, I think I'll be even
closer to her
world than I am now.
